newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 14.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 14.95 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills fell to 14.95 percent at the latest weekly tender after holding steady at 15.01 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 2.856 billion rand. The average price was 96.275 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 14.91 percent from 14.78 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 750 million rand. The average price was 92.565 rand percent.
